explanation.title: 句子插入題
explanation.analysis: 前一句說明會議目的是「檢視第二季成果並規劃未來優先事項」，插入句 (A)「專案負責人已經草擬了一份初步議程」承接「會議目的」的主題，並自然引出下一句「與會者若想提出其他議題，應在星期一前通知協調人」——因為已有初稿議程，員工才需要另外「補充」議題。(B) 提到公司年度報告發布時間，與會議議程無關；(C) 提醒繳交報帳單，與會議主題無關；(D) 提到大廳整修，與段落主題無關。
explanation.similarNote: 句子插入題常見的邏輯鏈是「先有既定安排 → 再說明如何補充或調整」，插入句若能解釋下一句「為什麼要這麼做」，通常就是正確答案。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p1q3
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 3

explanation.title: 連接詞（讓步）題
explanation.analysis: 空格後方 the meeting is expected to run for only one hour 與後半句 please keep your afternoon schedule flexible in case the discussion extends further 語意上是「雖然預期只開一小時，但仍建議保留彈性」的**讓步關係**，須用連接詞 **Although**（雖然，接完整子句）。(B) Because 表因果，語意不合；(C) In spite of 是介系詞片語，後面須接名詞而非完整子句；(D) Due to 同樣是介系詞片語，用法錯誤。
explanation.similarNote: Although / Though（連接詞 + 子句）與 In spite of / Despite（介系詞 + 名詞）是常見的混淆組，須依空格後方是「完整子句」還是「名詞」來判斷詞性。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p1q4
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 4

explanation.title: 時態與語態（未來式被動）題
explanation.analysis: 主詞 A finalized agenda 是「被發送」給與會者的對象，須用被動語態；且句意描述「會議前」即將發生的動作，須用**未來式被動** will be circulated。(B) circulates 為現在簡單式主動，語態與時態皆不合；(C) circulated 缺少助動詞，無法單獨作句子的主要動詞；(D) was circulating 為過去進行式，時態不合。
explanation.similarNote: agenda、report、notice 等文件類名詞常是被動語態的主詞，且公告類文章常見「will be + p.p.」描述即將發生的行政流程。

id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p2
title: 短文二：會議議程異動說明
passage:
Update on Meeting Agenda Changes

Dear Team,

Please note that the agenda for tomorrow's department meeting ______(5) since it was first circulated last week. Due to a scheduling conflict, the budget review session originally planned for 10 a.m. will now take place after lunch. ______(6). The venue remains the same, but the meeting will now ______(7) until 4 p.m. instead of ending at 3 p.m. If you have any concerns about how ______(8) affects your afternoon workload, please contact the meeting organizer directly.

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p2q5
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 5

explanation.title: 時態與語態（現在完成式被動）題
explanation.analysis: 句意為「自從上週議程首次發布以來，議程已經有所異動」，since it was first circulated last week 是現在完成式的典型時間線索，且議程是「被修訂」的對象，須用**現在完成式被動** has been revised。(B) is revising 為現在進行式主動，語態不合；(C) revised 缺少助動詞無法單獨作句子的主要動詞；(D) will revise 為未來式主動，與「已經發生的異動」語意不符。
explanation.similarNote: since + 過去時間點（last week）是現在完成式的經典搭配，須留意句子描述的是「從過去某時間點持續到現在」的狀態或動作。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p2q6
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 6

options.text: As a result, the morning session will instead focus on the marketing update presented by Ms. Tanaka.
The company was founded by three engineers two decades ago.
Employees are reminded to renew their parking permits this month.
The cafeteria menu will feature a new set of dishes next week.

explanation.title: 句子插入題
explanation.analysis: 前一句說明「原訂上午十點的預算檢討會議，將改到午餐後進行」，插入句 (A)「因此，上午的時段將改為由 Ms. Tanaka 主講的行銷更新報告」承接「時段異動」的主題，說明上午空出的時段由其他議程遞補，並與下一句「會場不變，但會議時間延長至下午四點」的整體議程調整語境一致。(B) 提到公司由三位工程師創立，與議程異動無關；(C) 提醒更新停車證，與會議主題無關；(D) 提到餐廳菜單更新，與段落主題無關。
explanation.similarNote: 議程異動類文章常見「某時段調整 → 說明替代安排 → 補充其他影響（如場地、結束時間）」的敘事順序，插入句需符合這個邏輯鏈。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p2q7
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 7

explanation.title: 動詞形式（助動詞 + 原形動詞）題
explanation.analysis: 空格前方有助動詞 will，其後須接**原形動詞** run（will run），表示「會議現在將持續到下午四點」。(B) runs 是第三人稱單數現在式，不可接在助動詞 will 之後；(C) running 是現在分詞/動名詞，同樣不可直接接在 will 之後；(D) ran 是過去式，文法上不能接在助動詞後面。
explanation.similarNote: 助動詞（will、can、must、should 等）之後一律接**原形動詞**，這是最基礎但常見的文法陷阱，須留意空格前方是否已出現助動詞。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程#p2q8
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/07_會議通知與議程
questions.stem: 題目 8

explanation.title: 代名詞（指示代名詞，單數）題
explanation.analysis: 空格所指代的是前面提到的「這次議程時間異動」這件單一事情（會議延後結束、時段調整等），屬於單數概念，須用**指示代名詞** this。(B) these 是指示代名詞複數形式，與單一事件的語意不合；(C) those 同樣是複數形式；(D) that 雖然也可指代單一事物，但通常用於指較遠或先前段落的內容，此處 this 更貼近「剛提到、正在討論中」的異動安排。
explanation.similarNote: this / that 常用於指代前面整句話或整個情境，須依「指代對象是單數或複數」以及「距離上下文的遠近」來判斷正確的指示代名詞。

id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p1
title: 短文一：供應商合作邀約信
passage:
Dear Mr. Navarro,

We at Aurora Textiles have long admired the quality of the fabrics your factory ______(1) over the past decade. We are writing today to propose a long-term supply partnership between our two companies. ______(2). Under this arrangement, we would commit to a minimum order volume each quarter in exchange for priority production scheduling and a discounted unit price. Our procurement director, who ______(3) previously with several overseas manufacturers before joining our firm, believes this partnership could benefit both parties considerably. We would like to discuss the terms further ______(4) a phone call or an in-person meeting at your facility.

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p1q1
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 1

explanation.title: 時態（現在完成式）題
explanation.analysis: 句意為「貴工廠過去十年來所生產的布料品質」，over the past decade 是典型的現在完成式時間線索，表示「從過去某時間點延續至今」的動作，主詞 your factory 為第三人稱單數，故用**現在完成式** has produced。(A) produces 為現在簡單式，僅表習慣性事實，無法呼應 over the past decade 的持續期間語感；(C) produced 為過去簡單式，僅指過去某單一時間點，未能涵蓋「延續至今」的語意；(D) will produce 為未來式，與「過去十年」的時間語境矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: 現在完成式（has/have + p.p.）常與 over the past + 時間、for + 時間、since + 時間點等副詞片語搭配，表示「從過去持續到現在」的狀態或動作。
explanation.similarNote: 合作邀約信開頭常先「稱讚對方過去的表現」，此類句子多用現在完成式，須留意句中的時間片語作為判斷依據。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p1q2
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 2

options.text: Specifically, we would like to become one of your primary buyers for the coming year.
Our design team recently attended a textile trade show in Milan.
Your factory was originally established as a small family business.
We recently switched to a new accounting software system.

explanation.title: 句子插入題
explanation.analysis: 前一句提出「我們希望與貴公司建立長期供應合作關係」，插入句 (A)「具體而言，我們希望成為貴公司來年的主要買家之一」承接「提議合作」的主題，並自然引出下一句「在此安排下，我們願意承諾每季的最低訂購量」的具體條件說明。(B) 提到設計團隊參加米蘭紡織展，與合作提議無關；(C) 提到工廠原本是家族企業，屬背景資訊而非合作條件；(D) 提到會計軟體更新，與供應合作主題無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 句子插入題不考文法規則，而是考「文意銜接」：插入句必須同時承接前一句的主題，並為下一句的內容做出合理的鋪陳。
explanation.similarNote: 合作邀約信常見「提出合作意願→具體說明合作方式→列出條件細節」的順序，插入句多半出現在「意願」與「條件細節」之間，作用是承先啟後。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p1q3
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 3

explanation.title: 時態（過去完成式）題
explanation.analysis: 句意為「我們的採購總監在加入本公司之前，先前曾與多家海外製造商合作過」，句中 before joining our firm 是一個過去的時間點，而「與海外製造商合作」這件事發生在「加入本公司」之前，屬於「過去的過去」，須用**過去完成式** had worked。(A) works 為現在簡單式，時態不合；(B) worked 為過去簡單式，僅表示單一過去動作，無法凸顯「早於另一個過去動作」的先後順序；(D) has worked 為現在完成式，語意會變成「至今仍在合作」，與 before joining our firm（已加入本公司）的語境矛盾。
explanation.grammarPoint: 過去完成式（had + p.p.）用來表示「在過去某一時間點之前已經發生」的動作，常與 before、by the time、already 等字搭配使用，凸顯兩個過去事件的先後順序。
explanation.similarNote: 句子中若同時出現兩個過去的時間點或事件，須先判斷何者發生在先、何者在後，較早發生的動作通常須用過去完成式。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p1q4
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 4

explanation.title: 介系詞（方式）題
explanation.analysis: 空格後方接 a phone call or an in-person meeting，句意為「透過電話或親自會面來進一步討論條件」，須用表「藉由、透過」方式的介系詞 **via**。(B) despite 表「儘管」，與此處欲表達的「討論方式」語意不合；(C) among 表「在…之中」，通常用於三者以上的比較或分配，與「討論方式」無關；(D) unless 是連接詞，須接完整子句，且語意「除非」與本句不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: via 是介系詞，後面直接接名詞或名詞片語，表示「透過某種方式或途徑」，常見於書信中說明聯繫或溝通管道。
explanation.similarNote: 表達「透過…方式」時，via、through、by 都可能出現在選項中，須依空格前後的詞性與語意判斷，並留意 via 通常較正式、常用於商業書信。

id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p2
title: 短文二：採購條件協商信
passage:
Dear Ms. Alvarado,

Thank you for your proposal regarding a long-term partnership between our companies. We are interested in moving forward, but before signing the agreement, we would like to renegotiate a few of the procurement terms. ______(5). Given the current volatility in raw material costs, we would ask that the unit price ______(6) fixed for only the first six months rather than the full year, after which it can be reviewed. We would also like all shipments to undergo a quality inspection ______(7) leaving your facility, in line with our standard procurement policy. With these two adjustments, we believe the revised agreement would be considerably ______(8) favorable to both sides than the original draft.

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p2q5
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 5

options.text: Specifically, we have concerns about two of the terms outlined in your draft: pricing and quality inspection.
Our factory has operated in this region for over thirty years.
We were impressed by the quality of your latest product catalog.
Our accounting department recently upgraded its invoicing software.

explanation.title: 句子插入題
explanation.analysis: 前一句提到「在簽署協議之前，我們希望重新協商幾項採購條款」，插入句 (A)「具體而言，我們對貴方草案中的兩項條款有疑慮：定價與品質檢驗」明確點出接下來要討論的兩個主題，並與後續句子（先談定價、再談品質檢驗）的順序完全呼應。(B) 提到工廠已在此地區營運三十年，屬背景資訊，與協商條款無關；(C) 提到對產品目錄印象深刻，屬稱讚語，與提出疑慮的語氣不符；(D) 提到會計部門更新發票軟體，與採購條件協商無關。
explanation.grammarPoint: 句子插入題須確認插入句能否「預告」後續段落的內容走向，本句插入句提到的兩個主題（定價、品質檢驗）分別對應後面兩句話，是判斷正確答案的關鍵線索。
explanation.similarNote: 協商信常見「先總括說明有哪些疑慮，再逐一展開細節」的寫作邏輯，插入句若能與後續段落的具體內容一一對應，通常就是正確答案。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p2q6
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 6

explanation.title: 假設語氣（ask that + 原形動詞）題
explanation.analysis: ask that 引導的子句屬於「建議／要求動詞+ that 子句」的假設語氣（虛擬語氣）結構，子句中的動詞須用**原形動詞**，不受主詞單複數或時態影響，故空格應為原形 be，句意為「我們要求單價只在前六個月維持固定」。(A) is、(B) was、(D) will be 皆為依主詞或時態變化的動詞形式，與假設語氣「原形動詞」的文法規則不符。
explanation.grammarPoint: require、ask、suggest、recommend、insist 等建議／要求動詞，後面接 that 子句時，子句動詞須用原形（虛擬語氣），例如 require that + 主詞 + (should) + 原形動詞。
explanation.similarNote: 凡看到 ask that、require that、insist that 等「要求／建議」句型，第一時間應直接判斷子句動詞為原形，不需再考慮主詞單複數或時態一致的問題。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p2q7
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 7

explanation.title: 連接詞（時間，表「先後順序」）題
explanation.analysis: 句意為「所有貨品在離開貴工廠之前，須先接受品質檢驗」，須用表「在…之前」的連接詞 **before**，說明「品質檢驗」發生在「離開工廠」這個動作之前。(B) despite 表「儘管」，語意不合；(C) although 表「雖然」，屬讓步關係，與此處單純的時間先後順序不符；(D) since 表「自從」或「既然」，皆與句意不合。
explanation.grammarPoint: before、after 為表示時間先後順序的連接詞，可直接接動名詞（V-ing）或完整子句；本句 before leaving your facility 即為「before + 動名詞片語」的用法。
explanation.similarNote: 表時間的連接詞（before、after、while、since）與表讓步或對比的連接詞（although、despite）常在同一組選項中混合出現，須先判斷句意是「時間關係」還是「邏輯轉折關係」再作答。

questions.id: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件#p2q8
questions.chapterId: reading/02_段落填空題/08_供應商合作信件
questions.stem: 題目 8

explanation.title: 比較級（more + 形容詞 + than）題
explanation.analysis: 句尾出現 than the original draft，是明確的比較級線索，句意為「這份修改後的協議對雙方而言會比原始草案更為有利」，須用**比較級** more favorable。(B) most 為最高級用法，須搭配 the 且不與 than 連用；(C) much 雖可修飾比較級（much more），但此處空格本身就是比較級的位置，much 單獨填入無法構成正確的比較句型；(D) very 只能修飾原級形容詞，不能與 than 搭配使用。
explanation.grammarPoint: 句中出現 than 時，前方形容詞或副詞通常須改為比較級（形容詞/副詞 + er，或 more + 形容詞/副詞），three-syllable 以上或多數以 -ful、-ive、-ous 結尾的形容詞須用 more 構成比較級。
explanation.similarNote: 判斷比較級題型的關鍵線索就是句中是否出現 than；若有 than，可先直接刪去最高級（most/the -est）選項，再依形容詞音節數決定原級加 -er 還是搭配 more。

id: reading/03_篇章閱讀題/01_綜合練習一#p1

questions.id: reading/03_篇章閱讀題/01_綜合練習一#p1q1
questions.chapterId: reading/03_篇章閱讀題/01_綜合練習一
questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this email?

options.text: To advertise a hotel's new renovation
To confirm a guest's upcoming reservation
To apologize for a canceled reservation
To request payment for a hotel stay

explanation.title: 主旨題
explanation.analysis: 郵件開頭即說明「感謝您選擇 Green Valley Hotel，本郵件確認您的訂房」，全文圍繞訂房細節、入住須知與注意事項展開，主要目的是**確認訂房**。(A) 裝修只是信中提及的附帶資訊，並非全文主旨；(C) 信中並未提及取消訂房；(D) 信中並未要求付款，只提到取消需注意的規定。
explanation.similarNote: 主旨題答案通常對應文章第一段（尤其是第一句）點出的目的，須留意「訂房確認信」「訂單確認信」「面試通知信」等常見商業書信的開頭套路。

questions.id: reading/03_篇章閱讀題/01_綜合練習一#p1q2
questions.chapterId: reading/03_篇章閱讀題/01_綜合練習一
questions.stem: What has the hotel provided to Mr. Thompson because of the renovations?

options.text: A discount on his room rate
A free upgrade to a suite

explanation.title: 細節題
explanation.analysis: 文章第二段明確提到：「因裝修可能造成噪音的不便，我們已為您每日入住期間安排一份免費早餐兌換券作為補償」，對應選項 (C)。(A)(B)(D) 皆為文章未提及的內容。

passage:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Harborview Foods Unveils Plant-Based Snack Line

Portland, March 3 — Harborview Foods, a regional snack manufacturer based in Portland, announced today the launch of its first plant-based snack line, branded "GreenBite." The new products, including roasted chickpea crisps and lentil crackers, will be available in grocery stores across the Pacific Northwest starting April 1.

"We have spent the past two years refining these recipes to make sure they taste as good as they are nutritious," said Marcus Delgado, Harborview's head of product development. "GreenBite reflects our commitment to offering snacks that customers can feel good about eating."

According to the company, the new line was developed in response to rising customer interest in plant-based options, with an internal survey showing that nearly 60 percent of Harborview's regular customers had asked for lower-sodium, allergen-free snack choices. To meet this demand, GreenBite products are produced in a dedicated facility that does not process peanuts, tree nuts, or dairy, making them suitable for customers with common food allergies.

Harborview plans to introduce three additional flavors later this year and is exploring distribution partnerships with national retailers. The company will host a tasting event at its Portland headquarters on March 20, open to the public by reservation.

★★★★☆ (4/5) — Posted by Daniel R.

I visited Blue Basil Bistro last weekend to celebrate a friend's promotion, and overall it was a pleasant experience. The restaurant's interior has a warm, inviting ambiance, with dim lighting and soft music that made it easy to hold a conversation. We started with the roasted eggplant appetizer, which was flavorful and generously portioned. My main course, the herb-crusted salmon, was cooked perfectly, though my friend felt her pasta dish was slightly bland compared to the description on the menu.

Service was attentive throughout the meal; our server checked in regularly without being intrusive, and any request for extra bread or water was handled promptly. The only drawback was the wait time — we had a reservation for 7:00 P.M. but were not seated until nearly 7:25, with no explanation offered for the delay.

Prices are on the higher side for the portion sizes, so I would not recommend this place for a casual weekday lunch, but it is well suited for a special celebration. I would return for the salmon alone, though I would call ahead to confirm my table will be ready on time.

**Model AX-220 Space Heater — User Guide (Excerpt)**

**Initial Setup**

Before turning on the heater for the first time, remove all packaging materials from the unit, including the plastic film covering the control panel. Place the heater on a flat, level surface at least 60 centimeters away from curtains, furniture, or any flammable materials. Do not operate the heater on carpeted surfaces unless the included stability base is attached, as this could cause the unit to tip over.

**Operation**

Press and hold the power button for two seconds to turn on the heater. The display will show the current room temperature; use the up and down arrows to set your desired temperature between 15°C and 30°C. The heater will automatically shut off once the room reaches the set temperature and will restart if the temperature drops more than 2°C below that setting. For safety, the unit is also equipped with a tip-over switch that immediately cuts power if the heater is knocked over.

**Maintenance**

Unplug the heater and allow it to cool completely before cleaning. Wipe the exterior with a dry cloth only; never use water or liquid cleaners, as moisture entering the vents may damage internal components. The air filter behind the rear grille should be removed and rinsed with water every three months; reinstall it only after it is fully dry. Using the heater with a wet or clogged filter may reduce heating efficiency and trigger the overheat protection feature.

**Troubleshooting**

If the unit shuts off unexpectedly and the display shows an "E1" error, this generally indicates the overheat protection has activated. Allow the heater to cool for at least 30 minutes before restarting. If the error persists, check that the air filter is clean and that nothing is blocking the front or rear vents.

explanation.analysis: Operation 段落明確提到：「為了安全，本機也配備傾倒開關，若暖氣機被撞倒會立即切斷電源」，對應選項 (B)。(A) E1 錯誤代碼是過熱保護啟動時顯示，與撞倒無關；(C) 文章提到 30 分鐘冷卻是排除故障時的建議，並非撞倒後的自動行為；(D) 穩定底座是用於地毯上防止傾倒，並非用來吸收撞擊力道。
explanation.similarNote: 說明書細節題常考「特定情境下會發生什麼」，須用題目關鍵字（knocked over）回文章定位對應句子。

To explain the cause of the noise and offer a free replacement
To inform Ms. Alvarez that her warranty has expired
To ask Ms. Alvarez to return the heater for a full refund

explanation.analysis: 客服回信第二段說明「因暖氣機仍在保固期內，我們希望安排免費更換，而非維修」，並在第一段解釋噪音成因（風扇葉片鬆脫），整體目的是**說明噪音原因並提供免費更換**，對應選項 (B)。(A) 客服並未要求顧客付費維修；(C) 保固仍在有效期內，並未過期；(D) 客服提供的是更換新品，而非全額退費。
explanation.similarNote: 客服回信的主旨常同時包含「原因說明」與「處理方案」兩部分，答案需涵蓋整封信的核心處理方式，而非只挑其中一句。

explanation.similarNote: 推論題常需比較文章中「舊批次」與「新批次／新版本」的差異描述，正確答案通常直接對應文章明確點出的差異點。

explanation.title: 字義題
explanation.analysis: 原句為 "we recommend against attempting to open the unit yourself, as doing so would void the remaining warranty"，此處 void 指使保固「失效、作廢」，語意最接近 **cancel**。(A) extend（延長）語意相反；(C) confirm（確認）與語境不符；(D) transfer（轉移）不符合此處指「保固失效」的意思。
